none: PAS FindID 984941: Roman siliqua of Arcadius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N ARCADI-VS [P]F AVG ; R/ VIRTVS [RO]-MANORV[M]

An incomplete, slightly clipped, silver, Roman siliqua of Arcadius (AD 383-AD 408) dating to the period AD 395-402 (Reece Period 21). VIRTVS RO-MANORVM reverse type depicting Roma seated left on cuirass, holding Victory on globe and inverted spear. Mint of Milan. As RIC X, no. 1227. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: D N ARCADI-VS [P]F AVG.…
